info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Asset Securitization Management API
info.description: The Asset Securitization Management API empowers financial institutions to efficiently handle the process of asset securitization. This API facilitates the submission of new asset securitization proposals, enabling users to initiate and manage asset-backed security transactions seamlessly. Typical consumers of this endpoint include banking professionals and treasury analysts aiming to optimize their asset management strategies. By providing a structured approach to asset securitization, this API supports enhanced decision-making and faster transaction cycles.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to start the process of asset securitization, enabling the conversion of illiquid assets into liquid securities. Using this functionality, businesses can leverage their assets for financial benefits.
